---
title: Add a settings page
description: Add a tab to the Settings section of the admin.
navigation:
  icon: i-lucide-sliders-horizontal
---

A settings page is a tab in `/admin/settings`. You add a page file and a registry entry.

## Step 1: write the page

Make the file `app/pages/admin/settings/reports.vue`.

```vue [app/pages/admin/settings/reports.vue]
<script setup lang="ts">
const { t } = usePlutoI18n()

useHead({ title: () => t('my-layer.settings.reports') })
</script>

<template>
  <div>
    <!-- The page content. Core renders the title and the tabs. -->
  </div>
</template>
```

Every page needs a title. Use a getter in `useHead`, so a language switch updates the title.

## Step 2: register the tab

```ts [app/plugins/pluto-extension.ts]
definePlutoExtension({
  id: 'my-layer',
  settingsPages: [
    {
      id: 'reports',
      order: 30,
      label: 'my-layer.settings.reports',
      icon: 'lucide:chart-bar',
      to: '/admin/settings/reports',
      capability: 'reports:read'
    }
  ]
})
```

- Use `capability: '*'` for an admin-only tab.
- Without a capability, every user in the admin sees the tab.
- The `order` of General is 0.

## Step 3: check on the server

The tab check hides the tab. It does not protect your data. The routes that the page calls must check the capability. For Supabase, use `requireCapability`. See [Users and roles](/supabase/users-and-roles).

## Optional: a panel on the General tab

For a small form, register a `settingsPanels` entry instead of a page. Core renders it on the General tab. A settings driver stores the values. Namespace the keys, for example `my-layer.page_size`.

## Optional: a section on the Email page

Register a `mailPanels` entry to add a section to **Settings, Email**. See [Mail](/core/mail).

## What you get for free

- The tabs show when 2 or more pages are visible.
- The sidebar **Settings** item gets one child for each visible page.
- The command palette gets a "Go to" command for the page.
- Core shows a no-permission alert instead of the page when the user lacks the capability.

See [Settings pages](/core/settings-pages).
